Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, what are you thinking about？
So you've got all the date spots researched, huh？
You're not gonna say you're tired already, right？
Have you been staring at me this whole time？
I'm a little sleepy... Guess that's nothing new, though.
What are you spacing out for？
I'm counting on my boyfriend to lead the way.
You'll wear yourself out if you get too excited.
Don't you think it's about time you made a move？
Hey, stop spacing out. It's not like you're entranced by me or anything.
Hey. Let's talk a little more.
Maybe we could stay like this a little longer.
How long are you gonna keep staring at me？
Our date's only just getting started.
Huh!？ Were you just looking at me？
I think I'm actually getting kind of excited.
You've got this big grin on your face. Having fun？
Today feels... kinda nicer than usual.
Is it okay if I just look at you？
Hehe. Guess it's the little things that make you happy.
Quit staring so much, you're making me nervous.
Hey, having fun？ Hehe, me too.
Maybe it'd be okay to get a little closer.
We're all alone right now... Not physically, I mean mentally.
Hey, um... Do you like me？ Actually, don't answer that.
I wonder how the two of us look to everyone else right now.
Stop paying so much attention to other couples, seriously.
When is the season for lovers, anyway？ I feel like people say that all year round.
Sometimes you just want your boyfriend to say things straight out, you know.
Hey, don't we seem like the perfect couple？
Hey, can I kick you？ Call it my way of expressing... whatchamacallit.
A boyfriend's hand is so warm. I wonder why.
Since we're a couple, maybe we could stick even closer together.
Oh, that couple over there... Well, not that I care.
Listen. You can't just make your girlfriend be the one to say everything.
Are we turning into a sappy couple or something？ Yeah, right.
We don't really need to do anything special when we're together, huh.
...Hehe, I saw that weird face you just made!
When it comes to you, I... Never mind.
People are staring. Not that I care. We're a couple, after all.
It's nice to take a detour every once in a while.
Isn't it kind of exciting going down a street we don't usually take？
We can just take it slow.
Everywhere's so empty on weekdays, huh.
A laid-back date like this is nice every once in a while.
There's barely anyone around today, huh？ ...Don't get any weird ideas.
I'd love to just hang out forever, but I guess we can't.
Getting to do stuff like this is one of the perks of being a student.
I wish we had a little more time to talk.
I wish we had way more time. For all kinds of things.
The weather's so nice it's almost annoying. Just kidding.
The sun's really strong today... I wish it'd tone it down a little.
I'm so glad it's sunny out.
Nice weather. Must be my good karma paying off.
It's kind of cloudy out. I hope it clears up.
It's actually kind of nice when it's a little cloudy like this.
Hmm, well, at least it's not raining.
Rain, huh... Do you like the rain？
Don't you have certain songs you feel like listening to on rainy days？
Even the rain can be fun. If you're in the right mood for it, anyway.
I wonder if there's somewhere cooler around here.
Mmm... The breeze feels really nice.
This kind of weather is so nice and comfortable.
This might be the best time of year for a date.
I wish I had a portable kotatsu right now.
It's pretty crowded... What a pain.
It's really crowded, so try not to get lost, okay？
Hmm... Well, I guess it's better than the place being completely dead.
I wonder if it's usually more crowded here.
There's a fair number of people here.
Could this place be a hidden gem？
Kind of feels like we have the place to ourselves.
You shouldn't let your guard down in front of me.
This might be your chance, you know？
Hey... I wouldn't complain if you got a little closer.
Why do you have to be such a tease...
...Oh, I don't think anyone's looking right now.
Hey, wanna kiss？ ...What would you do if I said that？
Alright, the day's just getting started.
Having plenty of time actually makes it harder to decide what to do, huh.
Make sure you don't waste any time.
Constantly checking the time on a date might cost you points, you know.
Doesn't it feel like time's flying by？
It's this late already... That's kind of a bummer.
I know it's cliché, but time really does fly when you're having fun.
It's getting pretty late, huh. Sigh...
Hey, what do you want to do？
You've got our date plan all worked out, right？
Planning ahead is important. Though I'm sure you know that.
Trying to guess your plan for today's date...
So, do you have the perfect plan lined up for today？
Maybe we took it a little too easy. Or do you think we're fine？
A date plan is just a guideline. You've gotta stay flexible.
Well？ Is today's date going according to plan？
So, what are we doing next？ Don't tell me you don't have a plan.
Hey, have you decided what we're doing after this？ Sure you're not forgetting anything？
I was actually looking forward to today, in my own way.
Do you actually think about that whole 'boyfriend walks on the street side' thing？
Where we go matters, sure, but who you're with and how you spend the time is what really counts.
I don't have a very long stride, you know. Much as I hate to admit it.
Oh, is that a cat？ ...Guess not.
We're walking at the exact same pace... Hehe.
Doesn't this make you wanna skip？ ...I'm kidding, obviously.
Kinda makes me feel like singing. Not that I'm going to.
Just thinking back on today's date.
Wonder what we should do for our next date...
Maybe we should go ahead and plan our next date.
Did my hardworking boyfriend wear himself out？
If we had a little more time, we could've enjoyed ourselves even more.
We're on a date, so let's keep the good mood going till the very end.
Guess our date's just about over...
I'm starting to feel like being a little selfish. Don't wanna give you a hard time, though.
That couple we passed earlier looked pretty jealous of us.
Might have some good dreams tonight... Like a continuation of our date.
Wonder how many times we've been here now.
I think I actually kinda like this place.
Did you know they filmed a TV drama here once？
I think there was some good-luck charm connected to this place, though I forgot it right away.
A friend of mine recommended this place.
Make sure you don't get lost.
Quit looking all over the place.
Wonder if there's anything weird around here.
Escorting me is your job as my boyfriend, right？
When you think of a date... what comes to mind？
Wonder if this place will become a fond memory someday, too.
No matter the place, there's never enough time to see all of it.
Well, no matter where we go, we rarely get the place all to ourselves.
Guess you'd call today perfect date weather？
Looks like there's a place to sit over there.
Places with lots of greenery are pretty relaxing.
Fresh air puts you in a better mood, doesn't it？
Whenever I'm outside, I always end up looking for stray cats.
I think I saw this place featured in a magazine.
Was this place like this last time, too？
So, do you come here a lot？
Isn't the air conditioning a little too strong？
Huh, so this is what's popular right now.
Now then, where should we start？
This place is bigger than it looks.
It's kind of loud in here.
Don't get carried away just because everyone else is.
I guess something like this isn't bad once in a while.
If you yelled in here, it'd probably echo. ...Just kidding.
Looks like we can take it easy here.
Ordering more... yeah, maybe I'll pass.
Hey, stop looking at the other tables.
I see, so it's this kind of place.
You're more put-together than I thought.
Do you actually clean in here？
You'd expect a guy's room to be a lot messier.
Time to check the bookshelf! Just kidding.
Aha, a dirty book! ...Made you jump, didn't I？
Don't you have anything surprising tucked away？
Quit fidgeting so much, will you？
I wonder how many times I'll end up coming to this room...
It really is a guy's room, huh...
Hey... it's okay if I come over again, right？
Let me know if you want something to drink.
You can relax a little more, you know.
Well？ It's cleaner than you expected, right？
I think my room's in pretty good taste, though...
Should I put on music... nah, never mind.
Stay away from that side of the room.
If you're that nervous, you'll make me nervous too... Come on, relax!
Staring around a girl's room like that is harassment, you know.
Just the two of us, huh...
This whole situation is a little much, you know.
I can't really settle down unless I'm doing something.
No way... Why do you even say stuff like that.
Hmm, so that's what you think.
...I don't think it's all that bad, though.
That's my boyfriend for you. Thanks.
Keep talking like that and someone's gonna hear us.
Why are you like this... Ugh... You're an idiot.
You don't have to worry. I only have eyes for you.
You don't need to worry. I'm fine, really.
You think so, too？ I see.
Oh, so you're going to say things like that？
I'll pretend I didn't hear that just now.
I don't want to hear it.
What a coincidence. I was thinking the same thing.
Actions speak louder than words, don't you think？
I'll keep that in mind for reference.
I have to respect my boyfriend's opinion.
I'm not so sure about that.
I'll take you seriously, you know？
